title: SOMA sign-in: Google test on localhost
_note: Test page for soma-platform PR #66 (packages/soma-signin with googleClientId). Serve it on http://localhost:5173 first.

steps.instruction: Click Sign in with Google and pick your account. Note what Google's window says under the title: it should name localhost, not supabase.co. The blue bar at the top turns to SIGNED IN when it works.
